implementation.range: Media content uses a seek-based bounded 1 MiB iterator, supports single ranges including suffix ranges, emits 206/Content-Range/Accept-Ranges, HEAD, ETag/Last-Modified and If-Range fallback to a complete 200 representation.
implementation.first_frame: VIDEO first/poster thumbnail generation seeks locally to the registered first frame and stores an immutable SHA/preset-keyed WebP cache entry; the smoke test asserts the tiny local fixture responds within the 2 second target.
implementation.safety: Content paths remain media_version_id-only and resolve below the registered project root; path escape is rejected before opening a file. IMAGE content remains blocked in favor of derived thumbnails.
implementation.cache: Thumbnail cache keys continue to include the immutable source SHA and normalized frame preset, so first/middle/last entries cannot alias one another.

performance_boundary.notes: The local FFmpeg fixture assertion is not Windows x64 UAT and does not claim a production benchmark or sustained concurrent playback result.

remaining: Real Windows x64 local proxy first-frame timing and four-way playback load remain pending.
A production-scale benchmark with representative codecs, cold cache and warm cache has not been run; this evidence intentionally remains PARTIAL.
